sentences.text: Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (NIEPVD Dehradun)

**Scheme Brief Description:** This scheme, implemented by NIEPVD Dehradun, provides free assistive devices and appliances to eligible persons with disabilities to enhance their independence and improve their quality of life.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Aids/Appliances

**Detailed Description:** The scheme &quot;Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances (ADIP)&quot; implemented by National Institute for Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun, aims to assist persons with disabilities in enhancing their physical, social, and psychological rehabilitation by providing them with modern, standard aids and appliances. Through this scheme, eligible visually, hearing, locomotor, and mentally disabled individuals receive necessary assistive devices free of cost or at a subsidized rate. The scheme is implemented by the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun.

**Benefits / Assistance:** - **For Visually Impaired:** Braille Kit, Daisy Player, Refractive Mirror, Mobility Cane, Smart Phone. - **For Hearing Impaired:** Hearing Aid. - **For Locomotor Disabled:** Wheelchair, Tricycle, Walking Sticks, Calipers, Crutches. - **For Mentally Disabled:** MR Kit. > **Note:** - For those with an annual income up to ₹22,500/-, the aid is provided completely free. - For those with an annual income up to ₹30,000/-, 50% of the cost of the aid must be borne by the beneficiary. <br>

**Application Process:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant should visit the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun and request a hard copy of the prescribed format of the application form. **Step 2:** In the application form, provide all the mandatory details, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attested, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the supporting documents to the National Institute for the Empowerment of Persons with Visual Disabilities (NIEPVD), Dehradun. **Step 4:** Request a receipt or acknowledgement from the concerned authority to whom the application has been submitted. > **Website:** [niepvd.nic.in](https://niepvd.nic.in/) > **Telephone No.:**0135-2736651, 2734016 > **Email:** tcab-niepvd@nivh.gov.in
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: National Institute For The Empowerment Of Persons With Visual Disabilities, Dehradun; Nodal Department: Department Of Social Welfare
